The test image shows a mango leaf with scattered white/pale powdery spots distributed across the surface. The spots are circular/irregular and appear as a dusty white coating in patches — classic powdery mildew appearance.

Now I'll view one reference image from Powdery_Mildew to confirm.

The reference image matches very closely: same scattered white/pale powdery patches on a green mango leaf, same distribution pattern. This confirms Powdery_Mildew.

- **Not Anthracnose**: no brown sunken spots or dark lesions
- **Not Die_Back**: no bark discoloration, no curling/wilting
- **Not Sooty_Mould**: no black soot-like encrustation — the spots are white/pale, not black
- **Powdery_Mildew**: white powdery patches scattered across leaf surface — matches both reference and symptom description perfectly
